newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish bonds largely flat ahead of U.S. data.
newsitem.headline: Swedish bonds largely flat ahead of U.S. data.

text.p: Swedish bond yields were little changed at midday on Friday with market players sidelined ahead of U.S. employment data, due at 1230 GMT, and the crown firmed marginally against the mark.
"It is quiet," a trader said. "Everyone is waiting for U.S. figures later in the day."
Swedish May employment figures are due at 1100 GMT with a Reuter survey showing analysts targeting a fall in unemployment to 7.9 percent from 8.3 percent in April.
The six-month T-bill rate fell one basis point to 4.22 percent while the ten-year bond yield rose one to 6.96 percent.
The crown managed to firm slightly to 4.4790 crowns to the mark from 4.4820 late on Thursday.

Dealers had feared that foreigners would hurt the currency by selling shares in Swedish fashion retailer Hennes & Mauritz after its Thursday decision to move from the Stockholm bourse's main A list to its smaller O list for tax reasons, but the share rebounded on Friday.
Several foreign institutional investors have internal rules saying they can only invest in shares on the primary list.
